meta.title: Oracle Pipeline — Lemma Demo
meta.description: Browser-only demo of the Lemma Oracle dashboard. Watch documents move through verification or run an inline verification of a bundled sample.

demoBanner.title: A read-only slice of the Lemma dashboard.
demoBanner.body: Pipeline rows below progress through verification in your browser. Pick a sample on the right to add it to the pipeline and watch the four-stage verification timeline open in the detail panel.
demoBanner.walkthrough: Walkthrough → pick a sample, then click the new row

sampleStrip.label: Try a sample
sampleStrip.hint: Adds a document at the top of the pipeline and opens its detail.

footbar.browserOnly: Browser-only demo · no data leaves your machine

financial_valid_approval.scenario: A regional bank approves a small-business loan; the applicant's exact income is never disclosed, only that it exceeds the policy threshold.
financial_valid_approval.outcome: All four stages verified. KYC/AML attribute proof anchored on-chain.

financial_tampered_output.scenario: Same loan, but the approval document was edited after the AI signed it.
financial_tampered_output.outcome: Output commitment did not match the value bound at issuance.

manufacturing_valid_process.scenario: An EU shipment's production process conformed to the registered ESG/CBAM specification.
manufacturing_valid_process.outcome: Process spec proof anchored on-chain; CBAM filing references the verified envelope.

manufacturing_model_swap.scenario: Same shipment, but a different AI inspection model was substituted between certification and shipment.
manufacturing_model_swap.outcome: Envelope signed under a different model hash than the one declared.

agent_valid_chain_with_x402.scenario: An autonomous agent purchases an API service via x402; Lemma proves delegation authority and payment authenticity.
agent_valid_chain_with_x402.outcome: Agent delegation chain + x402 payment proof verified.

agent_replay_duplicate.scenario: The same proof_id is submitted twice across two settlement steps (stuck retry loop).
agent_replay_duplicate.outcome: Replay rejected — proof_id already seen in a prior settlement.
